news.headline: 輝達董事會讓黃仁勳復職執行長（公司向 SEC 申報）
news.headline_en: NVIDIA board reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO (SEC filing)
news.plain: 輝達正式公告黃仁勳回任總裁兼執行長，結束 11 天的領導空窗。
news.plain_en: NVIDIA formally announced Huang's return as president and CEO, ending an 11-day leadership gap.
news.why_me: 你持有 81 股輝達。領導問題解除是好消息，但 SEC 調查還沒結束；股價大漲後輝達占你總資產約 22.0%，超過 20% 上限，照規則考慮減碼，不要追高加碼。
news.why_me_en: You hold 81 NVIDIA shares. The leadership issue is resolved, but the SEC probe is not; after the jump NVIDIA is about 22.0% of your assets, above your 20% cap — consider trimming per your rule, don't chase.

news.headline: 黃仁勳回歸，科技股與晶片股大反彈
news.headline_en: Tech stocks see monster rally after Jensen Huang returns as Nvidia CEO
news.plain: 輝達單日漲逾 31%，帶動那斯達克大漲 6.5%、標普 500 漲 4.7%，是 2025 年 4 月以來最好的一天。
news.plain_en: NVIDIA rose over 31%, lifting the Nasdaq 6.5% and the S&P 500 4.7% — the best day since April 2025.
news.why_me: 你的 Google、台積電、0050、00881 都跟科技股連動，今晚台股可能跟著反彈。一天大漲不代表跌勢結束，照計畫不追高。
news.why_me_en: Your Google, TSMC, 0050 and 00881 move with tech, so Taiwan may bounce today. One big up day doesn't end a downtrend; stick to the plan and don't chase.

news.headline: 美股大漲，美元升到 19 個月新高、10 年期殖利率約 4.94%
news.headline_en: Wall Street soars as Nvidia reinstates Huang, dollar jumps
news.plain: 股市反彈的同時，美元走強、長期利率仍在 5% 附近，代表市場還擔心 Fed 不降息甚至升息。
news.plain_en: While stocks rebounded, the dollar strengthened and long-term yields stayed near 5%, showing worries the Fed won't cut — or may even hike.
news.why_me: 週三（11/25）晚上的 PCE 物價數據很關鍵，若物價偏高，股市可能再跌。你的預備金規則門檻是標普 5,874，目前遠未觸發，不需動作。
news.why_me_en: Wednesday night's (11/25) PCE inflation data is key; hot inflation could hit stocks again. Your reserve trigger is S&P 5,874, far from triggered — no action needed.

events.plain: 你持有 19 股，每股 1.34 美元股息（約 25 美元，會先預扣 30% 稅）；今天之後買的人不能領這次股息
events.plain_en: You hold 19 shares; US$1.34 per share (about US$25, 30% withheld). Buyers from today on miss this dividend

valuation.name: Google
valuation.price_date: US close Mon 11/23/2026, Taiwan close Mon 11/23
valuation.note: 採用預估本益比、P/B、殖利率三法；PEG 因 EPS 含投資收益、成長率被灌水而排除。Morningstar 450 只當樂觀參考。
valuation.note_en: Uses forward P/E, P/B and dividend-yield methods; PEG excluded because investment gains inflate EPS growth. Morningstar $450 is an optimistic reference only.

valuation.name: 輝達
valuation.price_date: US close Mon 11/23/2026, Taiwan close Mon 11/23
valuation.note: 5 年平均本益比 32 倍含 AI 泡沫期，不採用；殖利率法（股息太少）與 PEG（試算表公式誤植，且 95% 成長不可持續）也排除。改用預估 EPS × 15～20 倍（S&P 500 約 18 倍），並以 P/B 286 交叉驗證。
valuation.note_en: The 32x five-year average P/E reflects bubble years, so it is not used; the yield method (tiny dividend) and PEG (sheet formula error, 95% growth unsustainable) are excluded too. Uses forward EPS × 15–20x (S&P 500 is about 18x), cross-checked with P/B 286.

valuation.name: 嬌生
valuation.price_date: US close Mon 11/23/2026, Taiwan close Mon 11/23
valuation.note: 四種方法都在 165～210 之間，結論一致：現價明顯偏貴。PEG 98 偏低（成長率被專利到期拉低）不採用。
valuation.note_en: All four methods land between 165 and 210, a consistent verdict: the current price is clearly expensive. PEG (98) is excluded as patent expiries depress growth.

valuation.name: 博通
valuation.note: 預估本益比與 PEG 都在 390 上下；P/B 受 VMware 併購影響偏低，只當下限參考；殖利率法股息太少不採用。
valuation.note_en: Forward P/E and PEG both land near 390; P/B is depressed by the VMware deal and serves only as a floor; the yield method is excluded (dividend too small).
